description: This file implements the JSON Web Token (JWT) handling, including encoding, decoding, signature validation, and related data structures within the Thunder Web namespace.

classes.name: JSONWebData
classes.description: A JSON container class representing the JWT header with algorithm and type fields.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::JSONWebToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JWT with a specified mode, key length, and key data, setting up the header.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token string, including optional signature if mode is SHA256.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token string into payload data, verifying signature and extracting payload.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::ValidSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of a JWT token based on the specified mode.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::PayloadLength
methods.description: Calculates the payload length from a JWT token string.
